Message.Name: Account Query Message
Message.Description: Returns the PRM API port's next expected user reference number

Message.Name: Modify Account Settings Message
Message.Description: Updates the settings for a given PRM Account

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: A unique sequential number starting from 1 at start of day

Field.Name: PRM Account
Field.Description: PRM Account in which the settings apply

Field.Name: Repeated Order Generation
Field.Description: Maximum allowed number of consecutive identical orders, previous value kept if -1

Field.Name: Trigger Restrict Symbol On Repeated Order Generation
Field.Description: Restrict symbol when order repetition limit is breached, previous value kept if ?

Field.Name: In Auction Market Order Prevention
Field.Description: Enable market order prevention, previous value kept if ?

Field.Name: In Auction Fat Finger Protection
Field.Description: Enable fat finger protection, previous value kept if ?

Field.Name: In Auction Market Order Protection
Field.Description: Enable market order protection, previous value kept if ?

Field.Name: Block and Cancel
Field.Description: Block, unblock or cancel open orders of this PRM Account, previous value kept if ?

Message.Name: Modify Order Book Restriction Message
Message.Description: Marks an Order Book as restricted or non-restricted for a given PRM Account

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: A unique sequential number starting from 1 at start of day

Field.Name: PRM Account
Field.Description: PRM Account in which the settings apply

Field.Name: Order Book
Field.Description: Order Book to be restricted

Field.Name: State
Field.Description: Describes whether the restriction is currently active, previous value kept if ?
